inventory.name: [NopalCyber] AWS CloudTrail Create New IAM Role

native_rule.creator: yugandhar.mocherla@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: Detects the creation of a new IAM role in AWS. An IAM role is an AWS identity with specific permissions that define what actions are allowed and which resources can be accessed. An attacker can exploit this by creating roles with broad permissions or malicious configurations, enabling them to assume those roles and gain unauthorized access to AWS resources. This can lead to privilege escalation, data exfiltration, unauthorized actions, or other security incidents.
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] AWS CloudTrail Create New IAM Role
